traditions.KJV: if thou be surety for thy friend , [ if ]

traditions.KJV: thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger ,

traditions.LXX: παγὶς γὰρ ἰσχυρὰ ἀνδρὶ τὰ ἴδια χείλη ,
traditions.KJV: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth ,

2.english_reference: thou art taken with the words of thy mouth

traditions.KJV: thou art taken with the words of thy mouth .

traditions.LXX: ποίει , υἱέ , ἃ ἐγώ σοι ἐντέλλομαι ,
traditions.VUL: Fac ergo quod dico fili mi ,
traditions.KJV: Do this now , my son ,
and deliver thyself ,

3.english_reference: when thou art come into the hand of thy friend

traditions.WLC: כִּ֘י בָ֤אתָ בְ כַף רֵעֶ֑ ךָ
traditions.LXX: ἥκεις γὰρ εἰς χεῖρας κακῶν διὰ σὸν φίλον ·
traditions.VUL: quia incidísti in manum próximi tui .
traditions.KJV: when thou art come into the hand of thy friend ;
go , humble thyself ,

traditions.KJV: and make sure thy friend .

4.english_reference: Give not sleep to thine eyes

traditions.WLC: אַל תִּתֵּ֣ן שֵׁנָ֣ה לְ עֵינֶ֑י ךָ
traditions.KJV: Give not sleep to thine eyes ,
nor slumber to thine eyelids .

5.english_reference: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand

traditions.LXX: ἵνα σώζῃ ὥσπερ δορκὰς ἐκ βρόχων
traditions.KJV: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand [ of the hunter ] ,

5.english_reference: and as a bird from the hand of the fowler

traditions.WLC: וּ֝ כְ צִפּ֗וֹר מִ יַּ֥ד יָקֽוּשׁ
traditions.VUL: et quasi avis de manu áucupis .
traditions.KJV: and as a bird from the hand of the fowler .

6.english_reference: Go to the ant , thou sluggard

traditions.LXX: Ἴσθι πρὸς τὸν μύρμηκα , ὦ ὀκνηρέ ,
traditions.KJV: Go to the ant , thou sluggard ;

traditions.LXX: καὶ ζήλωσον ἰδὼν τὰς ὁδοὺς αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.KJV: consider her ways ,
and be wise :
Which having no guide ,
overseer ,
or ruler ,

8.english_reference: Provideth her meat in the summer

traditions.KJV: Provideth her meat in the summer , [ and ]

8.english_reference: gathereth her food in the harvest

traditions.LXX: πολλήν τε ἐν τῷ ἀμήτῳ ποιεῖται τὴν παράθεσιν .
traditions.VUL: et cóngregat in messe quod cómedat .
traditions.KJV: gathereth her food in the harvest .

traditions.LXX: ἢ πορεύθητι πρὸς τὴν μέλισσαν καὶ μάθε ὡς ἐργάτις ἐστιν , τήν τε ἐργασίαν ὡς σεμνὴν ποιεῖται · ἧς τοὺς πόνους βασιλεῖς καὶ ἰδιῶται πρὸς ὑγείαν προσφέρονται , ποθεινὴ δέ ἐστιν πᾶσιν καὶ ἐπίδοξος · καίπερ οὖσα τῇ ῥώμῃ ἀσθενής , τὴν σοφίαν τιμήσασα προήχθη .

9.english_reference: How long wilt thou sleep , O sluggard ?

traditions.KJV: How long wilt thou sleep , O sluggard ?

9.english_reference: when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep ?

traditions.KJV: when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep ?
[ Yet ] a little sleep ,
a little slumber ,

10.english_reference: a little folding of the hands to sleep

traditions.LXX: μικρὸν δὲ νυστάζεις , ὀλίγον δὲ ἐναγκαλίζῃ χερσὶν στήθη ·
traditions.KJV: a little folding of the hands to sleep :

11.english_reference: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth

traditions.WLC: וּ בָֽא כִ מְהַלֵּ֥ךְ רֵאשֶׁ֑ ךָ

traditions.VUL: et véniet tibi quasi viátor egéstas ,
traditions.KJV: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth ,

11.english_reference: and thy want as an armed man

traditions.WLC: וּ֝ מַחְסֹֽרְ ךָ֗ כְּ אִ֣ישׁ מָגֵֽן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡ ἔνδεια ὥσπερ ἀγαθὸς δρομεύς .
traditions.KJV: and thy want as an armed man .

traditions.LXX: ἐὰν δὲ ἄοκνος ᾖς , ἥξει ὥσπερ πηγὴ ὁ ἀμητός σου , ἡ δὲ ἔνδεια ὥσπερ κακὸς δρομεὺς ἀπαυτομολήσει .
traditions.VUL: Si vero ímpiger fúeris , véniet ut fons messis tua , et egéstas longe fúgiet a te .

12.english_reference: A naughty person , a wicked man

traditions.KJV: A naughty person , a wicked man ,
walketh with a froward mouth .
He winketh with his eyes ,
he speaketh with his feet ,
he teacheth with his fingers ;
Frowardness [ is ] in his heart ,
he deviseth mischief continually ;
he soweth discord .

15.english_reference: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly

traditions.WLC: עַל כֵּ֗ן פִּ֭תְאֹם יָב֣וֹא אֵיד֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἐξαπίνης ἔρχεται ἡ ἀπώλεια αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly ;

15.english_reference: suddenly shall he be broken without remedy

traditions.VUL: et súbito conterétur , nec habébit ultra medicínam .
traditions.KJV: suddenly shall he be broken without remedy .

16.english_reference: These six [ things ] doth the LORD hate

traditions.LXX: ὅτι χαίρει πᾶσιν οἷς μισεῖ ὁ θεός ,
traditions.KJV: These six [ things ] doth the LORD hate :

traditions.KJV: yea , seven [ are ] an abomination unto him :
A proud look ,
a lying tongue ,

17.english_reference: and hands that shed innocent blood

traditions.KJV: and hands that shed innocent blood ,

traditions.KJV: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations ,

traditions.VUL: pedes velóces ad curréndum in malum ,
traditions.KJV: feet that be swift in running to mischief ,

19.english_reference: A false witness [ that ] speaketh lies

traditions.KJV: A false witness [ that ] speaketh lies ,

traditions.VUL: et eum qui séminat inter fratres discórdias .
traditions.KJV: and he that soweth discord among brethren .

traditions.KJV: My son , keep thy father ’s commandment ,

traditions.VUL: et ne dimíttas legem matris tuæ .
traditions.KJV: and forsake not the law of thy mother :

21.english_reference: Bind them continually upon thine heart

traditions.WLC: קָשְׁרֵ֣ ם עַל לִבְּ ךָ֣ תָמִ֑יד

traditions.WLC: בְּ הִתְהַלֶּכְ ךָ֨ תַּנְחֶ֬ה אֹתָ֗ ךְ

traditions.KJV: when thou sleepest , it shall keep thee ;

traditions.KJV: and [ when ] thou awakest , it shall talk with thee .

traditions.KJV: from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman .

traditions.KJV: Can a man take fire in his bosom ,

traditions.KJV: Can one go upon hot coals ,

traditions.KJV: and his feet not be burned ?

29.english_reference: So he that goeth in to his neighbour ’s wife

traditions.KJV: So he that goeth in to his neighbour ’s wife ;

traditions.WLC: לֹ֥א יִ֝נָּקֶ֗ה כָּֽל הַ נֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּֽ הּ

traditions.KJV: if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry ;

traditions.KJV: [ But ] whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding :

traditions.KJV: he [ that ] doeth it destroyeth his own soul .

traditions.KJV: neither will he rest content , though thou givest many gifts .
